texts.li: [once,summer] {FACTION}'s rider came back through the heat, dusty to the knees, with a short list. Last time's goods went down well. Now they'd like {TALE}, for {COUNT} silver, and they've sent a small gift for the colony's trouble.\n\nThey'll send for it in five days, and they want the whole order or none of it.

[again,colony:Hardworking] {FACTION} have stopped asking whether the colony can fill an order and started asking when. This time it's {TALE}, for {COUNT} silver, with the usual small gift.\n\nCollection in five days.

[mother,winter] {X_nameDef}, {A_nameDef}'s mother, has come through the snow from {FACTION}'s lands with a bundle of {A_nameDef}'s old clothes and a face that gives nothing away. She asks to see {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} together.\n\nNeither of them has gone out to the gate yet.

[father,!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, {A_nameDef}'s father, drove out from {FACTION}'s lands in a borrowed truck, left it at the bend in the road and walked the rest. He wants to talk to {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}, he says, and nothing else.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to go out to him first. {A_nameDef} hasn't said yes.

[sided,winter] Snow or no snow, {FACTION} haven't forgotten whose side the colony took against {ENEMY}. Their thanks came today, {TALE}, with frost on the wrapping.\n\n{ENEMY} haven't forgotten either, by all accounts.

[middle,!mediator] The peace the colony worked out between {FACTION} and {ENEMY} has lasted a whole season, and the two peoples are trading again. They've sent {TALE} between them, with a note signed by both.

[killed,winter] Tracks in the snow led {A_nameDef} to a small camp of {ENEMY}, a few hours away, with a thin line of smoke rising from it. {A_nameDef} swore {ENEMY} would answer for {DEAD}, and came back without a word.\n\nThe colony could draw them out to fight on its own ground, or let them move on.

[taken,lowtech] A shepherd brought word of a small band of {ENEMY} watering their horses at the ford, a few hours away. These are the people who took {DEAD}. {A_nameDef} wants them brought here, to fight on ground the colony knows.\n\nLeft alone, they'll be over the ford and gone by morning.

[years,guest,summer] The colony was founded here in the {PLACE}, in summer heat like this, {COUNT} years ago today. {A_nameDef}, who has been here longest, has been showing the young ones where the first tent stood.\n\n{X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, an old friend of the colony, has come to mark the day with a gift.

[years,noguest,winter] It's {COUNT} years today since the colony was founded. The snow is deep, and {A_nameDef}, the longest here, says it was deeper the first year, when there was no roof to keep it off.

[first,guest,lowtech] A year ago today the colony was a few people and a fire. {A_nameDef} has been here since that night. {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who traded the colony its first seed, has walked over to mark the day and brought something with {X_objective}.

lines.li: [lost] The feast went on late, and a place was set at the end of the table for the ones who didn't see this day. The chair stayed empty all night.
[first] The colony's first founding feast ran until the fire died, and before it was over they had agreed to hold one every year.
[lost] A quiet supper, and then {A_nameDef} walked out to the graves with a lamp and stayed a while.

texts.li: [summer] Half-empty wagons and a long, hot road ahead: {FACTION}'s summer caravan is bound for the market at {PLACE}. The caravan master will take {TALE} along and trade it there for {THING}, which the colony could use more of.\n\nThey'll be back in a week or so.

[lowtech] A boy from {FACTION} came running up the road ringing a hand bell: the harvest fair at {PLACE} opens tomorrow, with judging for the best of the harvest and buyers from all over. The colony could send a cart of {TALE}, and {A_nameDef} has already picked out the best of it.

[trait:Greedy] {FACTION} have invited the colony to their harvest fair at {PLACE}, and {A_nameDef} has already worked out what a cart of {TALE} would fetch there, and what the prize purse would add to it.

[nomeal] A lone traveler knocked at the gate as the light went: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, iced over and stamping {X_possessive} feet. It's {TALE} outside. The colony has little enough to share, but {X_nameDef} only asks to sleep somewhere out of the wind.

[meal,lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came to the gate at dusk with icicles in {X_possessive} hair, on the way home and caught out by the dark. It's {TALE}. There's {THING} in the stores and a fire going, and {X_nameDef} would be grateful for a corner near it.

[again,lowtech] The ice on the stream broke up in the night with a crack like a tree splitting. By noon the meltwater was running everywhere, and the colony was glad to see it.\n\n{A_nameDef} found {TALE} in the melt, dropped by some traveler over the winter.

[again,!lowtech] The gutters are running, the snowbanks are going gray, and someone has already set seedlings in pots along the windowsills. The thaw is here.\n\nOut on the road, {A_nameDef} found {TALE} in the melt.

[winter] Snowed in at the colony for a night, {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} heard {A_nameDef} talking about wanting to {GOAL}, and leaned across the table. {X_nameDef} did the very same, years ago. The two of them talked until the stove went out.
